alternatives.name: undici

validation_gaps: Confirm sync/async behavior and framework compatibility.

alternatives.name: Local rate-control helper
alternatives.rationale: A small local helper may replace a broad utility dependency when only debounce or throttle is used.
validation_gaps: Validate cancellation, leading/trailing invocation, timer, and concurrency semantics.

alternatives.name: Native date/time APIs
alternatives.rationale: Runtime date/time APIs may cover the observed capability.
validation_gaps: Confirm timezone, locale, parsing, and deployed runtime support.
